description: This file defines a Java class 'CreateSmsCampaignCommandHandler' which handles SMS campaign creation commands within the Fineract infrastructure. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and uses a service to process the creation of SMS campaigns. The class is annotated for command handling and transaction management.

classes.name: CreateSmsCampaignCommandHandler
classes.description: Handler class for processing create SMS campaign commands, integrates with the SMS campaign write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to create an SMS campaign by delegating to the service.
